activity.agents.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {All agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}
activity.agents.description: A menu button above the Activity tab's agent tabs: which agents have a tab (several can be ticked); with none ticked, all.

activity.all.description: The first entry of the Activity tab's Agents and Cards menus: no filter, everything.

activity.block.asked.defaultMessage: {other, select, yes {Edit waiting for your OK: {file} is locked by an agent of another project} other {Edit waiting for your OK: {file} is locked by agent {holder}}}
activity.block.asked.description: In the Activity tab, under Now: Combwork's file lock (Ask me) holds the agent's edit of a file another agent is editing until the user allows it. {file} is the file's path; {holder} the agent editing it.

activity.block.blocked.defaultMessage: {other, select, yes {Edit blocked: {file} is locked by an agent of another project} other {Edit blocked: {file} is locked by agent {holder}}}
activity.block.blocked.description: In the Activity tab, under Now: Combwork's file lock blocked the agent's edit of a file another agent is editing, while that stands. {file} is the file's path; {holder} the agent editing it.

activity.block.for.description: The second line of a lock block in the Activity tab: what blocked the edit, and for how long it has stood ({time}, such as "2 min").

activity.block.tip.defaultMessage: Shown while the lock stands: it goes once the other agent finishes, the agent tries again or moves on, or its turn ends. Its history is in the agent's ⋯ → Hooks…
activity.block.tip.description: Tooltip on a lock block in the Activity tab. ⋯ → Hooks… is the agent menu item: keep the arrow and the dots.

activity.cards.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {All cards} one {# card} other {# cards}}
activity.cards.description: A menu button above the Activity tab: only the agents working on these cards in progress have a tab (several can be ticked); with none ticked, all.

activity.cardsLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: the cards a session worked on.

activity.closeDetails.description: Tooltip of the button closing the Activity tab's details panel.

activity.column.defaultMessage: {column, select, hold {On Hold} todo {Todo} doing {Active} review {Review} passed {Approved} done {Done} other {{column}}}
activity.column.description: A card node's second line in the Activity tree: its board column. Use the board's column names.

activity.cpuLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details (HI-2111): the processor time a process has used.

activity.details.description: The Activity tab's details panel, for screen readers.

activity.empty.defaultMessage: Nothing is running. Start an agent to see what it runs here.
activity.empty.description: The Activity tab when no agent of the project runs anything (with Hide finished on, idle agents have no tab).

activity.emptyFiltered.defaultMessage: Nothing is running for this filter.
activity.emptyFiltered.description: The Activity tab, filtered to agents or cards, when none of them runs anything.

activity.endButton.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: ends this one process of the agent's, after a confirmation (…).

activity.endDetail.defaultMessage: Only this process ends, and only while it is still the one listed here. What it started keeps running, and the agent may see its command fail.
activity.endDetail.description: Detail of the confirmation before ending one of an agent's processes from the Activity tab.

activity.endFailed.description: An error's title: ending a process from the Activity tab failed.

activity.endIt.description: A button in the Activity tab's details for a process the agent's command left running (HI-2111): ends it, after a confirmation (…).

activity.endMessage.description: The confirmation before ending one of an agent's processes. {label} is what it runs, {pid} its id.

activity.endTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before ending one of an agent's processes from the Activity tab.

activity.ended.description: A notification: the process ({label}: what it ran) was ended from the Activity tab.

activity.endedNode.description: A node's second line in the Activity tab, live, once its process or session ended: it fades out, then leaves.

activity.heading.description: The Activity tab's heading: what the project's agents are running now, a tab per agent.

activity.hideFinished.description: A checkbox above the Activity tab (on by default): agents with nothing running (not running, or idle with no process or background task) have no tab.

activity.input.description: A heading in the Activity tab's details: the node's input exactly (a prompt, a tool call's input, a command line), with secrets masked.

activity.lastAction.description: A heading in the Activity tab's details: what the node did last (a reply, a tool call's result, an agent's status).

activity.lastActive.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: when a session was last active.

activity.live.description: A button above the Activity tab while it is frozen (as it always opens): goes live, showing updates as they come.

activity.liveTip.defaultMessage: Go live: show what runs as it changes. The tab opens frozen, a snapshot of when you opened it.
activity.liveTip.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's Play button (shown while frozen).

activity.loadFailed.description: The Activity tab when the project's sessions couldn't be read. {error} is the reason.

activity.loading.description: The Activity tab, or a detail in it, while it loads.

activity.map.agentsWorking.defaultMessage: {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {working, number} working
activity.map.agentsWorking.description: In the centre of the Activity map's shared view: how many agents it shows, and how many of them work.

activity.map.cardRole.description: In the centre of the Activity map: the agent's card ({card}, its key) and its role on it. Lower case role.

activity.map.context.description: In the centre of the Activity map: how full the agent's context window is, in percent (as its pane footer shows).

activity.map.contextUnknown.description: In the centre of the Activity map when the agent's context isn't known (no usage yet, or no window reported).

activity.map.count.description: Under a station's name on the Activity map: how many of the agent's tool calls in its current turn went there.

activity.map.doing.defaultMessage: {doing, select, tool {Using a tool} writing {Writing} other {Thinking}}
activity.map.doing.description: In the centre of the Activity map: what the agent does now.

activity.map.feedHeading.description: The heading of the Activity map's feed: the agents' latest tool calls.

activity.map.label.description: The Activity tab's map (a honeycomb of what agents do), for screen readers.

activity.map.loading.description: Under a station's name on the Activity map, and in its feed, while the agent's calls haven't been read yet. Lower case.

activity.map.needYou.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# needs you} other {# need you}}
activity.map.needYou.description: In the centre of the Activity map's shared view: how many agents wait for you.

activity.map.needsYou.description: On the Activity map: the agent waits for you (a question or a permission prompt).

activity.map.noCalls.description: The Activity map's feed when the agents shown have made no tool call in the turns read.

activity.map.notLoaded.description: Beside an agent's ring on the Activity map's shared view when it is past the agents the map reads (eight): its calls aren't on the map. Lower case.

activity.map.notReported.description: Under a station's name on the Activity map when the agent's CLI doesn't report that kind of call (not an observed zero). Lower case.

activity.map.partial.defaultMessage: From the latest calls read: not the whole history.
activity.map.partial.description: Under the Activity map's feed when its counts are a sample (an agent made more calls than the map counts, or more agents run than it reads).

activity.map.pct.description: Beside an agent's ring on the Activity map's shared view: how full its context is, in percent.

activity.map.prompt.description: On the Activity map and its feed: a prompt the agent was given (at the You station), named by this word only, never its text.

activity.map.ringTip.defaultMessage: {name}: {load, select, notLoaded {past the eight agents the map reads, so its calls aren’t shown} loading {its calls are being read} other {{known, select, no {context not known} other {context {pct, number}%}}}}. Click to show only this agent.
activity.map.ringTip.description: Hover of an agent's ring on the Activity map's shared view. {name} is the agent; {pct} its context in percent; known no: its context isn't known. Keep the select keys.

activity.map.show.description: Before the Activity tab's toggles for its map: Map, Feed, Context.

activity.map.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, working {Working} waiting {Waiting for you} failed {Failed or stalled} done {Done} other {Idle}}
activity.map.state.description: In the centre of the Activity map: the agent's state when it isn't working.

activity.map.station.defaultMessage: {station, select, you {You} read {Read} edit {Edit} shell {Shell} agents {Agents} other {Tools}}
activity.map.station.description: A station on the Activity map: where an agent's tool calls go. You: its prompts and questions to you; Read: reading and searching files; Edit: changing files; Shell: commands; Agents: subagents and background tasks; Tools: everything else (the web, skills, Combwork's tools, other tools). Keep each one short.

activity.map.stationTip.defaultMessage: {station}: {n, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} this turn, {heat, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} in the last ten minutes of the turns read. Last: {last, select, none {none} other {{last}}}
activity.map.stationTip.description: Hover of a station on the Activity map. {station} is its name, {n} and {heat} counts, {last} the last call's name (a file, a host or a tool), none when there is none. Keep the select keys.

activity.map.stripLabel.description: The Activity map's strip of the agents' context rings, for screen readers.

activity.map.toggleContext.description: A toggle above the Activity tab: show the agents' context rings on the map.

activity.map.toggleFeed.description: A toggle above the Activity tab: show the map's feed of the last actions.

activity.map.toggleMap.description: A toggle above the Activity tab: show its map (a honeycomb of what agents do).

activity.modelSwitch.description: In the Activity tab, under Now (HI-2609): the agent runs another model ({running}) than Combwork started it with ({launched}), its connection's. Both are model names ("GPT-6 Astra"); keep the arrow.

activity.modelSwitch.tip.defaultMessage: Its coding agent changed model by itself or at a prompt of its own. Shown while it runs the other model; restart the agent to go back to its connection's.
activity.modelSwitch.tip.description: Tooltip on the "Model changed" row in the Activity tab (HI-2609). Its connection is the account Combwork started the agent on.

activity.noPrompt.description: A turn node in the Activity tree whose prompt has no text (only images, say).

activity.notEnded.defaultMessage: {why, select, notOwn {{label} is no longer one of this agent's processes: nothing was ended.} cli {{label} is the agent's CLI: use Stop to end it.} other {{label} could not be ended: it may still run.}}
activity.notEnded.description: A notification after End Process in the Activity tab when it didn't end it: it had ended or isn't the agent's (notOwn), it is the agent's CLI (cli), or ending it failed. {label} is what it runs.

activity.notRunning.description: In the Activity tab, under Now, for an agent that isn't running.

activity.nowHeading.description: A heading in the Activity tab, over what an agent is doing in its turn now: its prompt, then the tool call under way (or thinking, or writing).

activity.openCard.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: opens the card.

activity.openSession.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: opens the session's transcript in the Sessions tab.

activity.orphanFact.defaultMessage: The process that started it has exited, and it has run for over ten minutes. The agent is told; Combwork doesn’t end it.
activity.orphanFact.description: The value beside Left running in the Activity tab's details (HI-2111): why this process counts as left running.

activity.orphanFor.description: A process node's second line in the Activity tab when the agent's command left it running, the shell that started it gone (HI-2111): its process id ({pid}), how long it has run ({time}: "12 min") and the processor time it has used ({cpu}: "3 min").

activity.orphanLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details (HI-2111): the process was left running by the agent's command.

activity.parentLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: the id of the process that started this one.

activity.pause.description: A button above the Activity tab while it is live: freezes it as it is (updates wait, counted in the pill).

activity.pauseTip.defaultMessage: Freeze it as it is: updates wait until you refresh or play.
activity.pauseTip.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's Pause button (shown while live).

activity.pidLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: a process's id.

activity.pill.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# update · Refresh} other {# updates · Refresh}}
activity.pill.description: A pill above the Activity tab while it is frozen: how many updates came since its snapshot; clicking it takes a new one. Keep "Refresh" as the action.

activity.pillTip.defaultMessage: Take a new snapshot with what came since. It stays frozen.
activity.pillTip.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's updates pill.

activity.process.description: A process node's second line in the Activity tree. {pid} is its process id.

activity.processFor.description: A process node's second line in the Activity tab: its process id ({pid}) and how long it has run ({time}: "4 min", "1 h 5 min").

activity.processesHeading.description: A heading in the Activity tab, over the processes an agent started (test runs, servers, scripts).

activity.promptFor.description: The line under an agent's prompt in the Activity tab: when it was given, as a duration ({time}: "4 min").

activity.reading.description: Beside the Activity tab's heading while the project's sessions are read (the tree shows running agents meanwhile).

activity.refresh.description: Tooltip of the Activity tab's refresh button: takes a new snapshot of what runs now.

activity.role.description: Beside an agent's name in the Activity tab when a card's builder and reviewer are both shown: its role on the card. Lower case.

activity.showAgent.description: A button in the Activity tab's details: shows the agent's terminal.

activity.showOwn.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {Show the agent’s own processes} one {Show the agent’s own process (#)} other {Show the agent’s own processes (#)}}
activity.showOwn.description: A checkbox beside the Activity tab's Processes heading: also shows the agent's own processes (its CLI, the terminal hosting it, Combwork's tool server for it), hidden by default. {n}: how many are hidden.

activity.started.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: when a turn, tool call, task or process started.

activity.state.defaultMessage: {state, select, working {Working} waiting {Waiting for you} failed {Failed or stalled} done {Done} other {Idle}}
activity.state.description: A node's state in the Activity tree: working, waiting for you, failed (or stalled), done, idle.

activity.statusLabel.description: A label in the Activity tab's details: the node's state.

activity.subagentsHeading.description: A heading in the Activity tab, over an agent's subagents and the background tasks it left running (a command, a monitor).

activity.tabsLabel.description: The Activity tab's row of agent tabs (one per running agent), for screen readers.

activity.task.defaultMessage: {type, select, subagent {Background subagent} command {Background command} monitor {Monitor} workflow {Workflow} other {Background task}}
activity.task.description: A background task node in the Activity tree: what kind it is.

activity.thinking.description: In the Activity tab, what an agent is doing when it works with no tool call under way and nothing written yet in its turn.

activity.toolFor.description: A tool call node's second line in the Activity tab while it runs: what it does ({summary}, from the agent, such as a command) and how long it has run so far ({time}: "40 s", "4 min").

activity.waiting.defaultMessage: {assistant, select, yes {Waiting for the Assistant’s answer: {reason}} other {Waiting: {reason}}}
activity.waiting.description: A line under the card an agent works on in the Activity tab (HI-2915): the card, in Active, is marked as waiting on purpose, so Combwork doesn't report it as stalled. assistant is yes when its agent asked the Combwork Assistant for something and waits for its answer; {reason} is why, in the agent's or the user's own words (for the Assistant, the request). Keep the select keys.

activity.workspace.agentIn.description: An entry of the Activity view's Agents menu: an agent ({agent}) and its project ({project}).

activity.workspace.assistant.description: The Assistant's group heading among the Activity view's agent tabs (its tabs grouped by project; the Combwork Assistant is its own group).

activity.workspace.cardNobody.defaultMessage: Nobody is working on {card} now. The card has its history.
activity.workspace.cardNobody.description: Activity's workspace level opened from a card ({card}: its key) when no running agent works on it now: past work is read on the card itself.

activity.workspace.clearCard.description: Tooltip of the button on Activity's "Working on HI-12" chip: drops the card's filter.

activity.workspace.empty.defaultMessage: Nothing is running in this workspace. Start an agent to see what it runs here.
activity.workspace.empty.description: Activity's workspace level when no agent of any project runs anything.

activity.workspace.forCard.description: A chip above Activity's workspace level when it was opened from a card, naming the filter (not saying anyone works on it): only the agents working on that card ({card}: its key, such as HI-12) now have tabs.

activity.workspace.heading.description: Activity's workspace level (the activity bar's Activity view): what every project's agents run now, their tabs grouped by project.

activity.workspace.noWorkspace.defaultMessage: Open a workspace to see what its agents run.
activity.workspace.noWorkspace.description: The Activity view's sidebar with no workspace open.

activity.workspace.panelTip.defaultMessage: What the workspace's agents run now. The whole workspace shows every project's running agents together; a project opens its own Activity tab.
activity.workspace.panelTip.description: The info tip beside the Activity view's sidebar heading.

activity.workspace.projectTip.description: Tooltip of a project's row in the Activity view's sidebar: opens that project's own Activity tab. {project} is its name.

activity.workspace.projects.description: A section heading in the Activity view's sidebar, over a row per project.

activity.workspace.showIn.description: A button in a Progress panel run's details, and an entry of a lane's menu: opens Activity's workspace level on that run's agent (or the lane's builder and reviewer), what it runs now.

activity.workspace.whole.description: A row of the Activity view's sidebar: every project's running agents together (as Performance's Whole workspace).

activity.workspace.wholeTip.defaultMessage: Every project's running agents, grouped by project, and the Assistant when it runs.
activity.workspace.wholeTip.description: Tooltip of the Activity view's Whole workspace row.

activity.writing.description: In the Activity tab, what an agent is doing when it works with no tool call under way, after it started writing its reply.
